title: SkillPyramid: A Hierarchical Skill Consolidation Framework for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.03692v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent AI agents can flexibly invoke skills to solve complex tasks, but their long-term improvement is fundamentally constrained by a lack of systematic skill construction, accumulation, and transfer. In particular, without a unified framework for skill consolidation, agents tend to redundantly construct similar capabilities across different tasks, are unable to effectively transform experience into reusable assets, and struggle to generalize task-specific skills to novel scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose SkillPyramid, a skill consolidation framework that reuses existing skill experience for broader task generalization. Operating on a hierarchical skill topology, SkillPyramid further introduces a self-evolution mechanism that enables agents to compose, validate, and incorporate new skills during task execution. translated_title: SkillPyramid：面向自进化智能体的层次化技能巩固框架
translated_abstract: 最近的AI智能体能够灵活地调用技能来解决复杂任务，但其长期改进从根本上受限于缺乏系统化的技能构建、积累与迁移机制。特别是，在没有统一的技能巩固框架的情况下，智能体往往会在不同任务中冗余地构建相似的能力，无法有效地将经验转化为可复用的资产，并且难以将特定任务的技能泛化到新场景中。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了SkillPyramid，一个能够复用现有技能经验以实现更广泛任务泛化的技能巩固框架。SkillPyramid在层次化的技能拓扑结构上运行，并进一步引入了一种自进化机制，使智能体能够在任务执行过程中组合、验证并纳入新技能。在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个基准上、跨越四个骨干模型的实验表明，SkillPyramid显著……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: SkillPyramid提出了一种基于层次化技能拓扑的技能巩固框架，通过自进化机制使智能体在任务执行中组合、验证并积累新技能，从而实现技能经验的复用与更广泛的任务泛化。
en_tdlr: SkillPyramid is a hierarchical skill consolidation framework that enables self-evolving agents to reuse, compose, validate, and accumulate skills during task execution, achieving broader task generalization.
